info.title: FastProof API
info.description: Test reporting server: projects, launches, uploads, results and attachments.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: A project key; with it, `audit:read` in that project is enough.

200.description: the bytes, with X-Content-Type-Options nosniff and a sandbox CSP
text/event-stream: `launch.updated` {id}, `upload.updated` {launchId, id}; `ready` first, `resync` after missed events
a launch with this externalId exists

get.description: Evaluates the project's quality gates for the launch now. `pending` while the launch runs or has unprocessed uploads; `failed` when a rule of an enabled gate that applies to the launch branch does not hold. A rule holds when `actual op value`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One status or a comma-separated list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring of the name, or words of the error message.

parameters.name: suite
parameters.description: A suite in the suite path.

requestBody.description: One ReportResult, a JSON array of them, or NDJSON (application/x-ndjson), see schemas/fastproof-report-v1.json

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Original file name of a single-file upload (helps detection).

requestBody.description: zip, tar, tar.gz, a JSON or XML report, or multipart with a `file` field

get.description: Notification and VCS deliveries, newest first (without targets or payloads).
Requests the project's FastMock answered during an attempt: by the attempt's trace id, else by its time window (and the `fastmock.space` label or launch attribute).
Names of the project's secrets; values are write-only.

put.description: Creates or replaces a secret, encrypted at rest with `FASTPROOF_SECRETS_KEY_FILE`. Settings refer to it by name (`secretRef`, `tokenSecretRef`).

AttachmentView.description: An attachment as referenced by a result or step.

id.description: Attachment id; `null` when the file was not part of any upload.

Attribute.description: A key/value attribute of a launch.

AuditList.description: A page of audit records, newest first.

Counts.description: Status counts of a launch (results, not attempts).

Defect.description: Triage of a result (filled in stage C).

DeliveryView.description: A delivery as the API shows it (no target, no payload).

ErrorBody.description: The uniform error body (`franshub_http::ErrorBody`), for the documentation.

ErrorView.description: Error details of an attempt or step.

GateReport.description:
The gate result of a launch: `pending` while the launch runs or uploads are processed,
otherwise `failed` when a rule of an enabled gate that applies to the branch does not hold.

GateRule.description:
A rule: it holds when `metric op value`. With `baseline`, `newFailures` compares with the
newest finished launch of that branch and the other metrics become the difference to it.

HistoryEntry.description: One result of a test case in a launch.

HistoryList.description: History of a test case, newest first.

Label.description: A key/value label (Allure labels, JUnit properties, CTRF tags, Playwright annotations).

LastLaunch.description: The newest launch of a project.

Launch.description: A launch: one run of a test suite, made of any number of uploads.

mergeRequest.description: Merge request IID (GitLab) or pull request number (GitHub) of the pipeline.

LaunchEnvironment.description: The named environment of a launch; `key` is part of every series identity.

externalId.description: Client key: starting a launch with an external id that exists returns that launch.

LaunchVcs.description: Version control metadata of a launch.

commitUrl.description: Link to the commit; computed for GitHub and GitLab repositories when not given.

Link.description: A link from a result (`type` is `link`, `issue`, `tms` or a writer-specific value).

Metric.description: A metric a gate rule checks.

fault.description: A fault FastMock injected (not recorded in the journal of FastMock 0.1).

matchedStub.description: Id of the stub that answered.

nearMiss.description: `true` when no stub matched (see FastMock's near misses for the closest ones).

MockInteractions.description: The requests correlated with an attempt.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how likely the items belong to this attempt.

truncated.description: More journal entries than were read could belong to the window.

items.description: A delivery as the API shows it (no target, no payload).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: A launch: one run of a test suite, made of any number of uploads.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: One result per series per launch.

message.description: Error message of the final attempt (first 500 characters).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

Parameter.description:
A test or step parameter.

`value` is `None` when the writer omitted it, and also after redaction of masked and
hidden parameters (see [`Parameter::redact`]); identity hashes are computed before
redaction, so they still cover secret values.

ParameterMode.description: How a parameter value may be shown.

ParameterView.description: A displayable parameter (masked and hidden ones are never returned).

Rejected.description: A result that was not accepted.

index.description: Position in the array or line number (zero-based) in NDJSON.

ReportAttachment.description: A reference to an attachment uploaded with `POST .../attachments`.

contentType.description: Content type to show; defaults to the one given at upload.

id.description: Attachment id returned by the server.

name.description: Name to show; defaults to the name given at upload.

ReportError.description: Error details of a result or step.

ReportResult.description: One attempt of one test, the unit of `POST /api/v1/projects/{key}/launches/{id}/results`.

fullName.description:
Stable full name (for example `com.example.CheckoutTest#pays`); identity is computed
from it unless `testCaseId` is given. Defaults to `name`.

id.description: Client id of this attempt, unique within the launch: sending it again is a no-op.

parameters.description: Parameters; `mode` `masked` or `hidden` values count for identity but are never shown.

start.description: Start, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

stop.description: Stop, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

testCaseId.description: Explicit stable test case id (takes precedence over the full name).

traceparent.description: W3C `traceparent` of the test, for correlation with traces.

ReportStep.description: A step; nested steps form a tree.

start.description: Start, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

stop.description: Stop, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

ResultDetail.description: A result with its attempts, steps and history.

ResultSummary.description: One result per series per launch.

message.description: Error message of the final attempt (first 500 characters).

actual.description:
The measured value (a difference to the baseline for metrics other than
`newFailures` when the rule has a baseline); `null` when it cannot be measured.

ScheduledJob.description: A periodic job of the scheduler.

SecretMeta.description: A secret as listed: the name only, never the value.

value.description: At most 8 KiB. Never returned by the API.

SeriesPoint.description: One past result of the same series.

Status.description: Final outcome of a test result, attempt or step.

TestCaseView.description: A test case (logical identity across parameters and environments).

TreeNode.description: A node of the launch tree.

format.description:
Requested format (`auto`, `allure`, `junit`, `ctrf`, `playwright`), replaced by the
detected one once processed.

UploadCounts.description: Uploads of a launch that are not done.
